chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi. He said: Abd al-Azim ibn Abdullah al-Hasani narrated to me. He said: al-Hasan ibn Abdullah narrated to me from Yunus ibn Zabyan. He said:

Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Fatima (peace be upon her) has nine names with God, Mighty and Majestic: Fatima, al-Siddiqa, al-Mubaraka, al-Tahira, al-Zakiyya, al-Radiya, al-Mardiyya, al-Muhaddatha, and al-Zahra.
Then he said: Do you know why she was named Fatima? I said: Inform me, my master. He said: She was severed from evil.

Then he said: Had the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) not married her, there would have been no match for her on the face of the earth until the Day of Resurrection — from Adam to those after him.

key_terms.الصديقة: al-Siddiqa — the Veracious, one who confirms divine truth
key_terms.المحدثة: al-Muhaddatha — one to whom angels speak; a degree below prophethood in Shia theology
key_terms.فاطمة: Fatima — from the root فطم (to wean/sever); she is severed from evil
key_terms.كفء: Kuf' — marital equal/match; a jurisprudential term in marriage law (kafaa)

ai.seo_question: What are the nine names of Fatima al-Zahra according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) enumerates the nine sacred names of Sayyida Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as recorded with God, then explains the meaning of her primary name 'Fatima' as one who is severed from evil. He further declares her incomparable status, stating that only Imam Ali (peace be upon him) was worthy of her as a spouse — a station surpassing Adam and all of humanity until the Day of Resurrection. This hadith was transmitted through Abd al-Azim al-Hasani, a highly respected descendant of Imam Hasan whose shrine is in Rey, Iran.
